reason: The local gate is the per-change proof for built executables.
The companion test module is compile-checked on every build gate.
Container tests run in the local build gate; release adds the full round trip.
Existing vet debt is a shrink-only set baseline in the local gate.
The GUI's separate self-test is part of the local build gate when GUI is built.
Preflight verifies tools, anchors, the stamped build and the full fdsec round trip before tagging.
The registry is checked on every local build gate.
Frozen winget anchors are checked before a tag and synced manifests before submit.
CI re-hashes all release assets before publishing them.
The tag workflow builds and smoke-checks the staged release artifacts.
WACK and the published privacy URL are pre-submission checks requiring an elevated operator session.
Listing and manifest tooling are run by the Store operator when Store copy or tooling changes.
Packed-manifest and stamp assertions run while building the Store submission package.
Scenario lists are operator-driven checks; their paths are placeholders the runner fills from FILEDO_TEST_TARGET, which must name a mounted VHD or a folder under %TEMP%.
The vendored glyphs are compared with the shared catalog, which lives only on the owner machine; the shell self-test holds the embedded bytes to PROVENANCE.txt on every build.
Every package carries THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt, written by hand; the gate holds its module sections to what each shipped executable links.
DOC-INTERNAL-QUALITY rules 1-3 and 5-7: the document registry both ways, relative links and anchors, house style and offline safety of the internal corpus, on every local build gate.
DOC-INTERNAL-QUALITY rule 4: the check flag and FILEDO_CHECK_* tables in the READMEs and the filedo_check option table are held to the parser inside the cmd/filedo suite.

DOC-EXTERNAL-QUALITY rules 1-7 over the published site and the READMEs: glossary and subject index, sitemap against the page set, SEO block, locale completeness and translation freshness, termbase, screenshots and prose hygiene, on every local build gate.

Re-takes the guide screenshots from the GUI and the MSI; it opens windows on the desktop, so the maintainer runs it after a GUI page or the installer feature tree changes. check-external-docs.ps1 holds the committed pictures (present, sized, alt text) on every build.
